profile_deletion.title: Delete this local profile?
profile_deletion.description: Permanently deletes local chats, drafts, saved API keys, PIN, recovery code, limits and spending records. A new profile cannot restore these conversations.
profile_deletion.remote_notice: API keys and provider accounts stay unchanged. Sent requests may still be charged.
profile_deletion.local_notice: Anyone with access to this screen can confirm deletion. Your PIN is not required.
profile_deletion.backup_notice: External exports and backups are kept. Secure erasure of all device copies is not guaranteed.
profile_deletion.progress: Deleting the local profile. Please wait.
profile_deletion.unavailable: Deletion is unfinished. Choose Finish deletion or restart Tokenlogue. New setup becomes available after deletion.
profile_deletion.success: The local profile has been deleted. Set up Tokenlogue again.
profile_deletion.preparation_notice: Confirmation first restricts access to the app data folder. If deletion cannot start, the profile is kept in that private folder.
profile_deletion.not_started: Deletion has not started. Return to sign-in and try again.
profile_deletion.directory_unsafe: Deletion has not started. Keep the app data and ask for help.
profile_deletion.backend_before: Deletion has not started. Unlock the system key storage and try again.
profile_deletion.changed_before: The profile changed. Deletion has not started. Return to sign-in and open a new confirmation.
profile_deletion.prepared_before: Deletion has not started. Your data is kept and its folder is now private. Return to sign-in and try again.
profile_deletion.ownership_before: Deletion has not started. Close other Tokenlogue windows, then try again.
